get_employment.description: Get one person's employment in full: job, manager, start date, status, and the personal, address and contract details Remote holds (which fields there are depends on the country).

parameters.name: employment_id

parameters.description: Also list their files (contracts, IDs, ...).

get_leave_balances.description: Get how much leave an employee has left, has booked and has taken, for each of their leave policies.

get_leave_balances.name: get_leave_balances

parameters.description: The employee. Pick one, or use an employment id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: employment_id

annual_balance.description: What is left of the yearly allowance. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

annual_entitlement.description: The yearly allowance. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

balance.description: What is left to book. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

booked.description: Booked, taken or not. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

current_entitlement.description: The allowance earned so far. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

pending_approval.description: Waiting for approval. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

taken.description: Already taken. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

upcoming_approved.description: Approved and still to come. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

used.description: Used. type is limited or unlimited; days and hours are set when limited.

count.description: How many balances, one per policy came back.
